intro.h2: Quoted fast, started on time, finished early
paragraphs: Garibay Flooring Co handles flooring installation in Brenham out of its location on S Chappell Hill St, plus remodeling work under the same roof. Their round red badge says it simply: flooring and remodel. Many customers find them the old-fashioned way, through a neighbor.

One homeowner reached out, had Mr. Garibay at her door the next day and a quote the morning after. She accepted on Friday, work began Monday, and the job was done by noon Tuesday, with painting and furniture moving included in the price. Another family has used them for many years and says they are always punctual and respectful of their time.

about.text: Garibay Flooring Co is a flooring and remodeling company at 2406 S Chappell Hill St in Brenham, Texas, led by Mr. Garibay. Homeowners find them through neighbors and friends, and some have stayed with them for years. Besides installing floors, the company carries flooring lines you can see in person in Brenham, and it has offered unusual options such as natural sea grass carpet. It is active in town too, running the silent auction for the Top Floor Cars & Ram Optical Car Show.

items.name: Janna T.
items.text: Mr. Garibay was recommended by a neighborhood friend to replace my floors.  He came by the day after I contacted him and provided a quote the next morning.  His quote wasn’t cheap but it was reasonable.  I accepted his quote on Friday.  He began Monday morning and was finished by noon on Tuesday.  His price included painting and moving furniture.  He did a great job, and most importantly, showed up when he said he would and efficiently finished the job without any delay or gaps in work.  I was very thankful to work with a trustworthy contractor that did a great job.  I would absolutely recommend them for quality, trustworthy work.

items.name: Mary S.
items.text: We've been working with them for many years, and they always do a fantastic job. Most recently, they installed new floors for us, and we loved the results. The installation was smooth, professional, and everything turned out beautifully. They were extremely punctual and respectful of our time, which we truly appreciate. We 100% recommend them!

items.name: Heather W.
items.text: Garibay Flooring Company did an outstanding job on our home renovation project. Their team was professional, punctual, and paid close attention to every detail. The quality of the materials and craftsmanship exceeded our expectations, and the results truly transformed our space. Communication throughout the process was clear and responsive, making the experience smooth from start to finish. I highly recommend Garibay Flooring Company to anyone looking for top-notch flooring services.

service_area.text: Garibay Flooring Co is based at 2406 S Chappell Hill St in Brenham, Texas, and Brenham is the town named on its Google and Facebook pages. If you want new floors or a remodel in or around Brenham, stop by during open hours or call (281) 640-4906 to check that your home is in their area and set up a visit.

items.q: How fast can you give me a quote?
items.a: Call and ask about current timing. One Google reviewer said Mr. Garibay came by the day after she contacted him and had a quote ready the next morning. She accepted on a Friday, and the work started the following Monday.

items.q: How long does a floor replacement take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the area and the flooring you choose. For one homeowner, the crew started Monday morning and finished by noon on Tuesday, without delays or gaps in the work. Ask for a schedule when you get your quote.

items.q: Does the price include moving furniture?
items.a: On at least one job it did: a reviewer said the price included painting and moving furniture. Every job is different, so ask Mr. Garibay to list exactly what your quote covers, including trim, moving furniture and any painting, before you say yes.

Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 4 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to 12 PM. Closed on Sunday. You can also email crisg@garibayflooringco.com any time with photos of your rooms and a rough idea of the square footage you need covered.

items.q: Can I see flooring in person?
items.a: Yes. Garibay Flooring Co invites customers to visit at 2406 S Chappell Hill St in Brenham. Their Facebook page has featured flooring lines in colors such as Ginger, Sugar, Cinnamon, Birch and Wreath, and options like sea grass carpet. Call ahead to ask what is in stock.

final_cta.text: Call Garibay Flooring Co or stop by the Brenham shop.
